configurations.description: VehicleRegistrationQuery -- ATDP (dealer), RP/RQ.P (in-state/OOS plate), RV/RQ.V (in-state/OOS VIN), RS (owner SSN), RN (owner Name). State-existence routing + Plate>VIN>SSN>Name guardrails. QV.P/QV.V NCIC shadows dropped (ACCEPTED_DIVERGENCES).
configurations.name: OH_LEADS_VehicleRegistrationQuery

configurations.description: DriverLicenseQuery -- DQ.O/DL (OLN), DQ.N/DN (Name). OLN>Name + State In/Out gates. ImageIndicator (Y) only on DQ.O.
configurations.name: OH_LEADS_DriverLicenseQuery

configurations.description: DriverHistoryQuery -- KQ.N (Name+DOB+Sex), KQ.O (OLN). DH-suffix fields. OLN>Name guardrail. Attention auto-handler. BMVIMS OLN shadow dropped.
configurations.name: OH_LEADS_DriverHistoryQuery

configurations.description: ImageQuery -- BMVIMS (OLN). Standalone driver-photo request, devdoc-Basic. autoSelect=$false so it is an officer opt-in and does not co-fire with every DriverLicenseQuery.
configurations.name: OH_LEADS_ImageQuery

configurations.description: GunQuery -- QG (serial; caliber/make/relatedHit optional). NCIC firearm query.
configurations.name: OH_LEADS_GunQuery

configurations.description: ArticleSingleQuery -- QA.S (serial+type), QA.N (NCIC#). serial>NCIC guardrail.
configurations.name: OH_LEADS_ArticleSingleQuery

configurations.description: BoatQuery -- BQ.H/BQ.R (Nlets, State), QB.H/QB.R (NCIC). State-existence routing + Hull>Reg guardrail.
configurations.name: OH_LEADS_BoatQuery
